title: Traigent first-run adapter configuration
description: Names the customer's own dataset fields, agent, evaluator and search space. scripts/generate_adapter.py validates it and writes a thin bridge that imports the callables unchanged. Argument tokens: "$input", "$expected", "$output", "$metadata", "$id", "$row" (agent only), "$config.<knob>" (agent only), or {"value": <literal>}. Nothing in this file is inferred: detection only suggests.

path.description: Tuning rows, .jsonl or .json, inside the project.

holdout_path.description: Held-out rows. Recorded only; the baseline never opens it.

input.description: Dotted field path of the agent input, e.g. input.text.

expected.description: Dotted field path of the expected answer.

split.description: Dotted field path of a split name; holdout-named rows are excluded from the baseline.

callable.description: module:function or path/file.py:function, a top-level function.

output_path.description: Dotted path into the returned dict or object, when the answer is nested.

calls_per_row.description: Provider calls the evaluator places per row (an LLM judge declares 1).

config.description: The agent's current configuration; every value must be in the space.

space.description: Knob -> list of distinct candidate values.

enhanced_space.description: Optional wider space for the later search; must contain every baseline value.

wired.description: Knobs the agent consumes. Default: every knob mapped as $config.<knob>.
